title: Smerdis the Magus
summary: Raleigh names Smerdis the Magus in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Smerdis the Magus, also written Cimerdius, the counterfait of Smerdis the Kings brother, who with Patizites possest the Empire. He is not Smerdis the sonne of Cyrus. The one-word title would fold onto smerdis, so the title is three words. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.
